name: timeZero
description: Time Zero for SEG-D timestamp in number of microseconds since the GPS epoch (6 January 1980).

name: recordSize
description: Total size of SEG-D record in number of bytes. May be zero if unknown.

name: dataSize
description: Total size of headers and data in this record in number of bytes. Enables skipping of all traces to beginning of trailer.

name: headerSize
description: Total size of headers. Enables skipping of all headers to beginning of first trace.

name: extendedRecMode
description: Set to 1 if record is using Extended Recording Mode and 0 for normal record.

name: relativeTimeMode
description: Set to 1 if record does not contain absolute timestamps or 0 for normal record. If 1 then timeZero must be set to 0.

name: unused
description: Currently unusued and can't take any value

name: headerBlockType
description: Must be set to 3 for GHB3.
